dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Slider was found in a children playground by a Good Samaritan who brought him to the care center. Since his arrival, Slider has been fearful although not aggressive. Time and staff/volunteer support did their job and Slider is slowly emerging from his shell. He is eating Churrus , accepts petting while sitting on his kuranda bed, does not try to hide and even comes down his perchoir, leaning into pets and head bunting my hand. Way to go, Slider! We are so proud of you! Nothing is known about Slider's past. He appears healthy, still needs to be neutered and his behavior evaluation reflects the fact that he was quite shaken up by what ever happened to him. An experienced, patient and understanding owner is what Slider needs to succeed in his new journey, in his new home. Slider is hoping to meet you soon!
dog.name: Slider
